name: Read a tender
summary: Extract stated tender/RFP clauses (scope, eligibility, deadline, BOQ) from a document, URL or pasted text.
author: friday-core
description: Read-only tender extract. Document bytes/URLs run as the built-in tender.read skill, which calls docs.extract then the shared field extractor (electron/tender-extract.cjs). This sandbox pack extracts from pasted text so capability-verify can run offline. Missing clauses stay missing.
